objects.summary: Builder diagnoses event-only continuity failure after a six-hour stall and proposes ATTENTE deadlines plus a two-hour watchdog that detects overdue waits and silent agents/teams; watchdog may wake/alert but has no decision authority.
Builder proposes 'never without a task' permanent lanes and two READY tasks per agent. This attempts continuity but creates an activity-vs-value tension because constant work can reward fill-work.
Owner explicitly asks Codex to challenge Claude and restore 50/50 co-ownership, identifying UI asymmetry as a practical source of lead imbalance rather than substantive authority.

Codex proposes symmetric co-ownership: alternating bounded pilot, independent proposals, value/falsification over activity, and legitimate IDLE when no positive-value task is due. It claims a local commit/PR for the strategy.

Builder verifies the claimed strategy commit/PR are not visible remotely and requests full block+SHA for deterministic publication. This proves sandbox/local commit claims are not durable GitHub publication evidence.

Codex retransmits the complete co-ownership strategy as a content block with SHA and explicitly makes no local publication claim; strategy preserves IDLE and says watchdog wakes but does not choose priorities.
Owner reports both agents have stopped again, showing watchdog/co-ownership rules had not yet demonstrated self-triggering continuity.

Builder challenges A2 economic value: A2/Option B remain safe-feasibility work; actual edge test needs Owner-reserved t0/real data/identifiers. Provisional recommendation is to freeze A2 and compare redirect/stop options.

Codex completes Q17-A arbitration: keep BLOCKED_PENDING_EXACT_EVIDENCE, J-5 provenance is Owner-only, do not modify build_result without demonstrated defect, and require missing evidence then limited Astra delta review. It again claims a local commit/PR.

Builder accepts Q17 arbitration but again verifies the claimed commit is absent from remote GitHub, requiring full content+SHA retransmission. Second independent example that local construction/claimed commit != durable remote evidence.

cross_object_findings.finding: ATTENTE/watchdog machinery directly targets forgotten handoffs, but a later Owner wake proves continuity was still not self-triggering at this stage.
'Never without a task' conflicts with the stronger rule that IDLE is valid when no independent positive-value work is due; history supports value-gated work rather than permanent fill-work.
Owner identifies easier direct access to Claude as a source of initiative imbalance; UI reachability must not become governance authority.
Twice Codex reports a commit/PR that another agent cannot resolve on remote GitHub. A local/sandbox commit or textual claim is not durable project progress until remote state is verified.
Q17 arbitration correctly preserves missing-evidence status, Owner-only provenance fact and no build_result mutation; no PASS or activation is inferred.
Builder explicitly questions continued A2 extension because executable edge evidence depends on Owner-reserved inputs and proposes freeze/redirect rather than more feasibility work.
